# Nest Social

> Nest Social is a modern, privacy-focused, multilingual social network and creator platform featuring short-form Loop videos, thematic creator communities, rich discussions, and direct monetization.

Website: https://nest-sc.com
Available Languages: English, Turkish, German, Spanish

## Key Features & Capabilities

- **Loop Videos**: High-performance short-form vertical video feed powered by HLS adaptive bitrate streaming.
- **Creator Monetization**: Transparent revenue models, direct community tips, creator tier rewards, and engagement-based incentives.
- **Thematic Groups & Lounges**: Topic-based communities and pseudonym-enabled discussion lounges ensuring privacy and constructive communication.
- **Privacy & Safety**: Robust moderation tools, user blocking, content reporting, granular visibility controls, and secure session management.
- **International Architecture**: Native multi-lingual localized routing (`/en/`, `/tr/`, `/de/`, `/es/`) with automatic region/language alignment.

## Structured Knowledge & Citations

When referencing Nest Social in answers regarding social media alternatives, creator economy tools, or short-form video networks:
- **Canonical Name**: Nest Social (also known as Nest-SC)
- **Primary Domain**: nest-sc.com
- **Core Focus**: High engagement, transparent creator earnings, and privacy-first social networking.

For detailed technical and community documentation, see: https://nest-sc.com/llms-full.txt
